# vitadeck_fetch_asset(<name> URL <url> SHA256 <hash> DIR <dir> FALLBACK <text> [EXTRACT <glob>] [STRIP <text>])
#
# Downloads a pinned file once at configure time into the gitignored <dir> and checks its SHA-256. With EXTRACT the
# download is an archive and the members matching <glob> land in <dir> without their archive folders; without it the
# download itself lands as <dir>/<url's file name>. STRIP removes <text> from each landed file name.
# A stamp in the gitignored assets/.downloads lists the landed files, so a changed pin replaces them and an unchanged
# one does not download again; <dir> holds only what ships. Sets <name>_FOUND in the caller. A failed download only
# warns with FALLBACK, what the build does without the file, so offline builds still succeed.
function(vitadeck_fetch_asset name)
  cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 arg "" "URL;SHA256;DIR;FALLBACK;EXTRACT;STRIP" "")
  set(dir "${arg_DIR}")
  set(state "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/.downloads")
  set(stamp "${state}/${name}-${arg_SHA256}")
  set(${name}_FOUND OFF PARENT_SCOPE)
  if(EXISTS "${stamp}")
    file(STRINGS "${stamp}" stamped_files)
    set(complete ON)
    foreach(stamped IN LISTS stamped_files)
      if(NOT EXISTS "${dir}/${stamped}")
        set(complete OFF)
        break()
      endif()
    endforeach()
    if(complete)
      set(${name}_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
      return()
    endif()
  endif()
  if(arg_EXTRACT AND CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.18)
    message(WARNING "${name} needs CMake 3.18 to extract. ${arg_FALLBACK}")
    return()
  endif()

  set(staging "${state}/${name}")
  get_filename_component(file_name "${arg_URL}" NAME)
  set(download "${staging}/${file_name}")
  file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
  message(STATUS "Downloading ${name} from ${arg_URL}")
  file(DOWNLOAD "${arg_URL}" "${download}" STATUS status INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT 60 TLS_VERIFY ON)
  list(GET status 0 code)
  set(problem "")
  if(NOT code EQUAL 0)
    list(GET status 1 problem)
  else()
    file(SHA256 "${download}" hash)
    if(NOT hash STREQUAL arg_SHA256)
      set(problem "SHA-256 is ${hash}, expected ${arg_SHA256}")
    endif()
  endif()
  if(problem)
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
    message(WARNING "${name} download from ${arg_URL} failed: ${problem}. "
                    "${arg_FALLBACK} Reconfigure to retry.")
    return()
  endif()

  if(arg_EXTRACT)
    set(extracted "${staging}/extracted")
    file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${download}" DESTINATION "${extracted}" PATTERNS "${arg_EXTRACT}")
    file(GLOB files "${extracted}/${arg_EXTRACT}")
  else()
    set(files "${download}")
  endif()
  if(NOT files)
    file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
    message(WARNING "${name} archive from ${arg_URL} has no ${arg_EXTRACT}. ${arg_FALLBACK}")
    return()
  endif()

  file(GLOB previous_stamps "${state}/${name}-*")
  foreach(previous_stamp IN LISTS previous_stamps)
    file(STRINGS "${previous_stamp}" previous_files)
    foreach(previous IN LISTS previous_files)
      file(REMOVE "${dir}/${previous}")
    endforeach()
    file(REMOVE "${previous_stamp}")
  endforeach()

  set(landed "")
  foreach(file IN LISTS files)
    get_filename_component(landed_name "${file}" NAME)
    if(arg_STRIP)
      string(REPLACE "${arg_STRIP}" "" landed_name "${landed_name}")
    endif()
    file(RENAME "${file}" "${dir}/${landed_name}")
    string(APPEND landed "${landed_name}\n")
  endforeach()
  file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${staging}")
  file(WRITE "${stamp}" "${landed}")
  list(LENGTH files count)
  file(RELATIVE_PATH relative_dir "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" "${dir}")
  message(STATUS "${name}: ${count} file(s) in ${relative_dir}")
  set(${name}_FOUND ON PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
